title: Track Star
description:
Build. Train. Compete. Win.Track Star is a track & field career simulation. Start as a lowly high school freshman, build your athlete week by week, and find out if you've got what it takes to win a national title, earn a college scholarship, turn pro, and win a gold medal. 

Every week is a decisionEach week you manage your training load, protect your energy, and decide which meets are worth the risk. Push too hard and you're injured. Play it too safe and your rival pulls ahead. There's no perfect playbook, every week presents a choice.

World events shape your seasons too. A heat wave tanks a week of training. A rival school produces a phenom who's suddenly on your radar. The news cycle doesn't stop for your training schedule.

Build the athlete you want Choose your specialty and shape your career around it. A Sprints build plays completely differently from Distance or Jumps. Your stats, training focus, and event selection all compound across your career. By the time you're racing for your country, you'll know exactly what kind of athlete you built.

Qualify or go homeThe championship path is real and it's unforgiving. Make your Class meet. Advance to State. Survive Regionals. Only a few athletes reach Nationals — and only one wins. Then, do it again, up through the college ranks and as you try to make a national team and compete globally. 

Fall short and you're running the annual Turkey Trot with everyone else who peaked too early.

The rivalry is personalEvery career has a rival. They show up at your meets, they remember your times, and they're not rooting for you. Whether you chase them down or spend your whole career in their shadow depends entirely on the athlete you built.

As one chapter ends, another beginsCollege recruitment isn't guaranteed. By senior year of high school, your performance history either opens doors or closes them. Some athletes walk away with scholarship offers. Some walk away with a good story. A few walk away with both.

The cycle repeats in college. Do you have what it takes to make your national team or win a pro contract, or will you have to hang up your spikes?

Pro and international competitionRun well enough and you can earn a national team spot, race in U20 and continental championships, and if you're lucky, the World Championships and Global Games. 

The real elite will have the opportunity to turn pro. Your world ranking decides which meets want you. You start in the Challenger Series, earn invitations to the Horizon Tour, and fight for a spot in the Laurel League, where the season ends at the League Final. A new world of sponsors, rankings, world records, and more comes alive.

But your peak doesn't last forever. Training stops building you up and age starts dragging you down. It all comes to an end after a maximum 16-year pro career.

Features• A 24-year career divided across high school, college, professional and international track and field

• Weekly training and competition loop with energy management

• Multiple athlete specializations, each with distinct playstyles

• Championship qualification ladder: Class → State → Regionals → Nationals in high school; Conference → Regionals → Nationals in college; national team qualification and international championships

• Dynamic rival system that tracks your career arc

• World events engine that shapes your seasons with real context

• College recruitment, national team selection, professional qualification, and sponsorship contracts shape every phase

• A pro circuit with sponsors, prize money, and a season-ending League Final.

• Hard Mode for athletes who think they've seen everything

• Hall of Fame and career records across playthroughs

• Animated Race Results 

• Dozens of achievements and milestones

Disclosure

I use Claude Code to assist in game development, but all content, narrative, formulas, etc. are created by me.
description_short: From high school freshman to world-class pro. Train week by week, earn a scholarship, race for your country, and chase a world record before age catches up with you. Choose your specialty, build your athlete, and beat your rivals on the way to greatness.
